edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with dogCore.ceoAddress() to gate privileged functions via onlyCEO.
msg.sender must equal finalLottery before a term can be flagged as rewarded.
msg.sender must equal finalLottery before SpoolAmount is increased.
registerLottery requires address(dogCore) == msg.sender, tying the caller to dogCore.
finalLottery state variable is the sole authorization for rewardLottery.
finalLottery state variable is the sole authorization for toSPool.
random() overwrites randomSeed directly from block.timestamp, making draws timestamp dependent.
random2() mixes block.timestamp into keccak256, making carousel draws timestamp dependent.
random() computes its result as keccak256(randomSeed, block.difficulty) % seed, a miner-influenced value.
random2() computes its result as keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty) % totalSupply.
random() narrows the hash-derived uint256 to uint8, truncating high bits of the draw.
toLotteryPool performs SpoolAmount -= amount on unsigned state (guarded by require(SpoolAmount >= amount)).
toSPool performs unchecked SpoolAmount += amount.
distributeLottery computes legalAmount = totalAmount - lotteryCore.SpoolAmount() with unsigned values.
distributeLottery splits rewards with reward*95*9/1000 style multiplications and divisions that round down.
_getValidRandomGenes derives min and loop bounds from luckyDog and totalSupply with unchecked arithmetic.
distributeLottery calls the external dogCore.sendMoney inside nested owner loops while term state is still incomplete.
distributeLottery performs external calls to lotteryCore (getCLottery, rewardLottery, toSPool, bonusPool) before finalizing its own accounting.
openLottery performs an external self-call this._isCarousal(), handing control to the callee mid-execution.
openCarousel performs an external self-call this._isCarousal() before writing term state.
_validGenes reads external dogCore state (getDog, ownerOf) while scanning for valid genes.
_getGen0Address resolves the gen0 owner through external dogCore.getDog and ownerOf calls.
registerLottery queries the external dogCore.ownerOf before pushing registration state.
